title: Ampirical and Entergy: A partnership powering Louisiana’s workforce, communities and future
summary: Ampirical Solutions, LLC — a long standing engineering and grid services partner to Entergy Louisiana — is expanding its headquarters and plans to add 175 new high wage technical jobs.
body_markdown:
Ampirical Solutions, LLC — a long‑standing engineering and grid‑services partner to Entergy Louisiana — is expanding its headquarters and plans to add 175 new high‑wage technical jobs. This growth will deepen Louisiana’s energy workforce, accelerate critical grid and data‑center projects and fuel statewide economic momentum.


The expansion comes at a pivotal moment for the energy sector. Aging infrastructure, rising electrification, resilience investments, increasing renewable integration and the rapid surge in data‑center development are driving unprecedented demand for utility expertise. These trends are not only reshaping the industry, but they’re also creating sustained, long‑term opportunities for companies like Ampirical Solutions, LLC to support more complex, large‑scale projects across Entergy Louisiana’s service territory.


“Today’s utility customers want strategic partners who can support a broader scope of project work,” said Ampirical Solutions, LLC CEO Matthew Saacks. “Beyond design engineering and project management, we’re increasingly providing studies, testing and commissioning, and ongoing operation and maintenance activities. Because so many of our employees are here in Louisiana, we can meet rising demand through local hiring at all experience levels, allowing us to onboard a workforce that builds both skill and culture.”


Entergy Louisiana’s grid‑hardening, modernization and data‑center‑enablement programs are delivering tangible benefits across the state. Whether powering a data center in the north or supporting an LNG facility in the southwest or a steel plant in the southeast, these efforts strengthen local economies far beyond the project sites themselves. Communities benefit from increased sales‑tax revenue, expanded local services, growing educational needs and wider economic activity, all sparked by jobs and investment that ripple throughout the region.


Ampirical Solutions, LLC’s office expansion also sends a clear signal: the company is committed to a long‑term presence in Louisiana. Stakeholders understand that continued demand for technical, project‑based and business‑support roles means sustained job creation for the region. “High‑paying, sustainable jobs are the foundation of strong economic development,” Saacks said. “When companies invest in people, communities gain stability, more financial resources and greater appeal to new businesses, creating a flywheel effect of continual growth.”


Saacks also emphasized Ampirical Solutions, LLC’s focus on being an agile, future‑ready partner for Entergy Louisiana as the state transforms into a high‑demand energy and digital‑infrastructure hub. “Ampirical works every day to be the best strategic partner it can to Entergy Louisiana, and that means our leadership works to plan future needs. We continually review resource loading of employees and contractors to ensure sufficient project capacity to meet demand. We adopt lessons learned and best practices from other capital projects. We use our innovation to drive added value that stretches capital dollars further. We also work with higher education to optimize workforce planning and training.”


Together, Ampirical Solutions, LLC and Entergy Louisiana are not just powering infrastructure, they’re powering opportunity, resilience and long‑term prosperity for communities across Louisiana.
